horses.incident_text: Jumped only fairly.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Bumped on jumping.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.
No report.
When placed under pressure over the final 300 Metres hung out, resulting in its rider M F Poon having to stop riding and straighten near the 150 Metres.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.

Bumped heavily at the start.  Between the 250 Metres and the 150 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running and approaching the 200 Metres blundered when being shifted to the inside of FLOWING RICHES.
Bounded on jumping and lost ground.  After the 150 Metres was shifted to the inside of GET FRIENDLY to continue into clear running.

Shifted out at the start and was bumped.  M L Yeung reported that his mount lay out and away from SMART GOLF after the 200 Metres.  He added that after the 100 Metres when he used the whip in his left hand he aggravated an old injury to his left shoulder which restricted him being able to fully apply the whip over the concluding stages.  Jockey Yeung was subsequently examined by the Chief Medical Officer and passed fit to fulfil his remaining riding engagements.
Near the 450 Metres made contact with AQUAMAN and became unbalanced due to both runners shifting ground.

Shortly after the start made contact with CHATER FLASH and became unbalanced.  Raced greenly throughout the event and near the 150 Metres was steadied when crowded between LUCKY PLUS and FLOWING RICHES which lay out and away from SMART GOLF when that runner shifted out as it hung out.
Jumped only fairly and then was bumped by FLOWING RICHES which shifted out.  Near the 450 Metres made contact with FORTUNE WARRIOR and became unbalanced due to both runners shifting ground.

Bumped heavily at the start.  Near the 200 Metres was shifted to the outside of HYANNIS STAR to obtain clear running and over the concluding stages could not be ridden out when being eased to avoid HONORARY which shifted in.  J McDonald reported that his mount raced greenly throughout the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Bumped on jumping.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Bumped at the start and became unbalanced.  Near the 400 Metres lay in and was awkwardly placed close to the heels of JOLLY JUMPER which shifted out.  Lay in in the Home Straight.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Bounded on jumping and then shortly after was steadied when crowded by MAJESTIC DELIGHT which shifted out.  Held up for clear running between the 450 Metres and the 350 Metres.  Sent for sampling post-race.

On jumping was steadied when crowded between YOUNG HORIZON and HE WAS ME which shifted in despite the efforts of its rider.  Between the 450 Metres and the 300 Metres was held up for clear running behind BLING BLING GENIUS.
After being crossed by COLONEL leaving the 800 Metres commenced to race keenly and near the 600 Metres shifted out when being steadied away from COLONEL.  Sent for sampling post-race.
A Badel pleaded guilty to a careless riding charge for causing interference near the 500 Metres (see SMART ENGINEER).
Shifted out at the start and was bumped.
Briefly held up for clear running near the 400 Metres.  C L Chau confirmed that from a wide barrier he was instructed to ride his mount in a conservative manner in the early stages.

Near the 200 Metres became held up for clear running behind COLOURFUL WINNER and was then shifted to the outside of COLOURFUL WINNER in an attempt to obtain clear running.  Passing the 100 Metres was then steadied when disappointed for clear running between COLOURFUL WINNER and MY FLYING ANGEL.  As a result TEAM HAPPY could not be fully tested to the finish of the event.

Shifted in and made contact with THE CONCENTRATION on jumping.  Near the 300 Metres was steadied when crowded between SMART ENGINEER which shifted out and away from COLONEL and JOLLY JUMPER (Apprentice E C W Wong) which shifted in.  Apprentice Wong was reprimanded and advised he must make a greater effort to prevent his mounts from shifting in when not clear.
Raced very wide and without cover from the 800 Metres.  Near the 250 Metres was hampered when taken wider by HE WAS ME which shifted out.

Jumped only fairly.  A Badel (MY FLYING ANGEL) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that near the 500 Metres he allowed his mount to shift out when insufficiently clear of SMART ENGINEER, resulting in SMART ENGINEER losing its rightful running and having to be checked.  A Badel was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Sunday, 7 December 2025 and to expire on Thursday, 11 December 2025 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In addition, Jockey Badel was fined $90,000.  In assessing penalty, the Stewards determined the carelessness grade 1 and the consequences grade 2 and also considered his poor race riding record.

On jumping made contact with the right side of its starting gate and lost ground.  Near the 250 Metres was hampered and taken wider by ISLAND GOLDEN.  M L Yeung reported that after settling back in the field his mount found it difficult to make up ground in the Home Straight, particularly with the middle stages of the event being run outside of standard time.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  After the race the Veterinary Surgeon reported that the horse had sustained a minor abrasion to the right hind leg.

horses.short: Must pass veterinary exam before racing again
horses.incident_text: D Probert could offer no explanation for the horse’s failure to finish the race off in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Before being allowed to race again, COLONEL will be subjected to an official veterinary examination

blackbook_suggestions.reason: Must pass vet exam before racing again

horses.incident_text: Shortly after the start shifted out and away from GLACIATED.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.
Bumped at the start.
In the early stages despite being ridden along failed to show sufficient pace to hold a more forward position.
Bumped at the start and became unbalanced.
No report.
Shifted out at the start and was bumped.
Slow to begin.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

K Teetan stated that his mount gave ground badly in the Home Straight and he had some concerns that there may have been something amiss with it.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race which included an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea.  The performance of GIMME FIVE was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, GIMME FIVE will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
M L Yeung reported that his mount resented the kickback throughout the race.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Bounded on jumping, shifted out and made contact with REZEKI.  The performance of BILLION TWO, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  As this was the third occasion the horse had tailed out, BILLION TWO will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in consecutive barrier trials and be subjected to an official veterinary examination which must include additional diagnostic assessments.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Bumped heavily at the start.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped only fairly.
On jumping made heavy contact with EVER LUCK, became unbalanced and lost ground.

Leaving the 750 Metres shifted out and away from the running rail and made contact with CROSSBORDERDUDE when that runner shifted in and away from CONRAD THE GREAT.  As a result CROSSBORDERDUDE then shifted in slightly due to the contact, resulting in STRAIGHT TO GLORY being checked when reluctant to hold its position to the inside of CROSSBORDERDUDE.
Between the 400 Metres and the 300 Metres was held up for clear running.
No report.
Made contact with the right side of its starting gate and lost ground.  For some distance near the 1000 Metres was awkwardly placed close to I P O BROS when that runner was being shifted in.
Jumped awkwardly, shifted out and then was steadied to avoid CROSSBORDERDUDE when that runner shifted in slightly.
Shifted in shortly after the start, was bumped on the hindquarters and became unbalanced.  Leaving the 750 Metres was bumped on the hindquarters and became unbalanced.

C Y Ho reported that on jumping his left foot made contact with the starting gate partition.  Jockey Ho was subsequently examined by the Chief Medical Officer and passed fit to fulfil his remaining riding engagements.
Jumped awkwardly.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.

Had difficulty obtaining clear running between the 400 Metres and the 300 Metres.  When being shifted to the outside of AMAZING DUCK near the 300 Metres made contact with THE LION KING.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Bounded on jumping and lost ground.  Near the 450 Metres was checked to avoid AUDACIOUS PURSUIT when SMART FAT CAT improved behind AUDACIOUS PURSUIT.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.
Bumped and taken wider near the 300 Metres by AUDACIOUS PURSUIT.

Jumped only fairly.  Between the 450 Metres and the 250 Metres was held up for clear running.  Approaching the 150 Metres was eased and shifted to the inside of GLORIASTAR to continue into clear running.  C Y Ho reported that the intention was to hold a more forward position but after beginning only fairly his mount did not show sufficient pace to do so.
Jumped only fairly.
Lay out making the Home Turn.
Raced very wide and without cover from the 800 Metres.
No report.

M F Poon stated that from the outside barrier he was given the option of holding a more forward position.  He said whilst TIME TO FIRE commenced well it did not show sufficient pace in the early stages to do so and as a consequence settled back in the field.  He added that with the early stages of the event being run outside of standard time TIME TO FIRE finished the race off only fairly in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Near the 1400 Metres was steadied to avoid OLDTOWN when shifting in to obtain cover behind that runner.

Held up for clear running between the 400 Metres and 300 Metres.  Near the 200 Metres was steadied to avoid CONSPIRACY WITNESS (A Atzeni) which, after improving to the inside of PEARL OF PANG’S was then taken in slightly as PEARL OF PANG’S was giving ground.  A Atzeni was advised to exercise more care in similar circumstances.

Knuckled over on jumping.  When caught very wide in the early stages was ridden forward near the 800 Metres to cross GLORIASTAR after which PEARL OF PANG’S raced wide and without cover thereafter.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

J McDonald could offer no explanation for the horse’s disappointing performance. Trainer W Y So expressed disappointment with the performance of OLDTOWN but added that the horse was disadvantaged by carrying 134 lbs at its first run over 1600 Metres.  He added that it is his intention to relocate the horse to Conghua Racecourse for a freshen-up and will barrier trial OLDTOWN before racing again.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  Sent for sampling post-race.
From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
No report.
Shortly after the start was eased to avoid FUN N FUN TOGETHER which shifted out.
Shortly after the start was bumped by MUST GO which shifted out when being eased.  Near the 700 Metres was eased when racing tight to the inside of VICTORY SKY which shifted in.
Jumped awkwardly.  After being crossed by VICTORY SKY near the 800 Metres commenced to race keenly and was steadied for some distance thereafter.

Apprentice E C W Wong reported that his mount was pressured in the lead by METRO POWER and AURORA PATCH and as a result was left without a finishing effort in the Home Straight.  Trainer F C Lor stated that he was pleased with the horse leading into the race and concurred with the views of Apprentice Wong that FUN N FUN TOGETHER was unsuited by being pressured in the lead.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Sent for sampling post-race.
K Teetan reported that his mount hung out making the turns in the middle stages of the event.

Bumped on jumping.  D Probert reported that he was asked to ride the horse where comfortable.  He said when his mount jumped well he was obliged to make use of it in the early stages to cross runners to his inside to avoid racing wide.  He said as a consequence QUARTZ LEGEND did not finish the race off when under pressure in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Jumped only fairly.  M F Poon stated that after settling back in the field the horse found it difficult to make up ground in the Home Straight under its 134 lbs.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Shifted in at the start and was bumped.  L Hewitson reported that his mount, which was having its first race start on the All Weather surface, did not appreciate the tighter turns before giving ground in the Home Straight and not running out a strong 1200 Metres.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Near the 150 Metres made contact with YOUNG CHAMPION when it improved into a tight run between STEPS AHEAD and YOUNG CHAMPION.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped awkwardly.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.
No report.

Jumped only fairly.  Near the 700 Metres was steadied to avoid STEPS AHEAD.  A short distance later was shifted to the outside of STEPS AHEAD and as a result made contact with YOUNG CHAMPION near the 600 Metres.  Near the 150 Metres was steadied and shifted out and away from YOUNG CHAMPION when that runner was bumped and taken wider by HONG LOK GOLF (H Bentley) which improved into a tight run between STEPS AHEAD and YOUNG CHAMPION.  H Bentley was reprimanded.  In this incident SAGACIOUS LIFE was taken out and as a consequence made contact with TALENTS AMBITION.

Near the 700 Metres was hampered when taken wider by SHANWAH which shifted out when being steadied to avoid SAGACIOUS LIFE.  Bumped near the 600 Metres.  Near the 150 Metres was bumped by HONG LOK GOLF and became unbalanced.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.

K Teetan stated that he was obliged to steady his mount near the 600 Metres to avoid SHANWAH and in the Home Straight his mount finished the race off reasonably well.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race which included an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, MICKLEY will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

Jumped awkwardly and then became unbalanced when bumped by TALENTS AMBITION which shifted in.  For a short distance after the 100 Metres could not be fully ridden out when racing tight to the inside of PRAY FOR MIR.
Shifted in at the start and was bumped.  Near the 150 Metres was bumped and taken wider by SAGACIOUS LIFE.
No report.
Bumped at the start.  Between the 350 Metres and the 250 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running.

As the start was effected sat back in the barriers and consequently was slow to begin.  The barrier manners of CHIU CHOW SPIRIT were considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, CHIU CHOW SPIRIT will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial.  H Doyle reported that in this incident CHIU CHOW SPIRIT got its head up, resulting in it making contact with her head.  Jockey Doyle was subsequently examined by the Chief Medical Officer and passed fit to fulfil her remaining riding engagements.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to be a "roarer” which had previously been reported.

SHANWAH, which was leaning on the left side of its starting gate, jumped awkwardly and made contact with MR ASCENDENCY.  Near the 700 Metres shifted out when being steadied to avoid SAGACIOUS LIFE.  SHANWAH then improved to the outside of SAGACIOUS LIFE (J McDonald) as that runner was being shifted to the outside of STEPS AHEAD, resulting in SHANWAH having to be steadied when crowded between YOUNG CHAMPION and SAGACIOUS LIFE.  J McDonald was severely reprimanded and advised he must ensure that he is sufficiently clear when shifting ground.  K De Melo reported that his mount raced keenly and as a consequence in the Home Straight did not finish the race off.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Shifted out shortly after the start and was bumped.
Lay out in the Home Straight, resulting in its rider H Doyle changing her whip to her left hand after the 100 Metres.
No report.
No report.

Bumped on jumping.  Near the 100 Metres was crowded for room between CHATEAUNEUF and YOUTHFUL SPIRITS which shifted in and away from COLOURFUL KING when giving ground.  The Stewards were satisfied that L Hewitson, rider of YOUTHFUL SPIRITS, had endeavoured to correct his mount when it commenced to shift in.  J McDonald stated that with his mount dropping back to 1000 Metres it did not travel well due to the early stages of the event being run inside of standard time.  He added that, in his view, MAGIC CONTROL may be better suited by being stepped up in distance for its next race start.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Shortly after the start became unbalanced when it made contact with BABY CRYSTAL.  Near the 50 Metres was crowded between KAHOLO ANGEL and YOUTHFUL SPIRITS which, after making contact with MAGIC CONTROL, then shifted out when giving ground.
Shifted in near the 100 Metres when giving ground and bumped MAGIC CONTROL.  YOUTHFUL SPIRITS then shifted out and made contact with WONDER KIT.
Bumped on jumping.  After travelling a short distance was then eased when crowded between CHATEAUNEUF and MAGIC CONTROL.
No report.

H Bowman stated that his mount had difficulty obtaining clear running for some distance after the 250 Metres and finished the race off only fairly thereafter.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
No report.
No report.
Apprentice E C W Wong pleaded guilty to a careless riding charge for causing interference passing the 1100 Metres (see LIGHTNESS OF MUSIC).  Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped awkwardly.  Between the 350 Metres and the 300 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Bumped with ALPHA STRIKE shortly after the start.  Making the first turn near the 900 Metres hung out and made contact with GOLDENTRONICMIGHTY which shifted in despite the efforts of its rider.  Z Purton reported that his mount hung out throughout the event.  He added that when racing tight to the inside of ALPHA STRIKE in the early stages his mount lost ground when it shifted out towards ALPHA STRIKE.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.

Jumped only fairly.  In the early stages got its head up when being shifted across behind runners.  Between the 400 Metres and the 300 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running and near the 300 Metres made contact with CORNERSTONE when being shifted to the outside of TRIUMPHANT MORE.

On jumping made heavy contact with LIGHTNESS OF MUSIC, became unbalanced, shifted in and made contact with ALPHA STRIKE.  Held up for clear running between the 450 Metres and the 350 Metres.  Near the 250 Metres was steadied and shifted to the inside of ALPHA STRIKE to continue into clear running.
Bumped near the 300 Metres.

Shifted in making the first turn near the 900 Metres and made contact with SUPER STRONG KID.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to be a "roarer” which had previously been reported.
Jumped only fairly.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Jumped only fairly.

Made heavy contact with ARMOR GOLDEN EAGLE on jumping.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  Apprentice E C W Wong (MATTERS MOST) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that passing the 1100 Metres he allowed his mount to shift in when not clear of LIGHTNESS OF MUSIC, resulting in LIGHTNESS OF MUSIC having to be checked to avoid MATTERS MOST and further he continued to allow his mount to shift in when not clear of ALPHA STRIKE, resulting in ALPHA STRIKE having to be also checked to avoid MATTERS MOST.  Apprentice Wong was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Wednesday, 17 December 2025 and to expire on Sunday, 21 December 2025 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In addition, Apprentice Wong was fined $30,000.  In assessing penalty, the Stewards determined the carelessness grade 2 and the consequences grade 2 and also considered his neutral race riding record.  M Chadwick stated that after being crowded in the early stages his mount raced too keenly before giving ground in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race which included an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, LIGHTNESS OF MUSIC will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

Bumped shortly after start.  Checked passing the 1100 Metres (see LIGHTNESS OF MUSIC).  Raced keenly throughout the early and middle stages of the event and refused to settle.  C Y Ho stated  that his mount was crowded in the early stages before giving ground in the Home Straight.  Trainer C Fownes stated that, in his view, the disappointing performance was due to the manner in which the horse raced throughout the early and middle stages.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of ALPHA STRIKE, a last start winner, was considered disappointing.  Before being allowed to race again, ALPHA STRIKE will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

Withdrawn on 29.11.25 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (irregular heart rhythm) and replaced by Standby Declared Starter MATTERS MOST.  Before being allowed to race again, WINGS OF WAR will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Shifted out at the 350 Metres and made contact with TOURBILLON PRINCE.
No report.
No report.
Bumped near the 300 Metres.
Near the 300 Metres was shifted to the outside of SIX PACK to obtain clear running and as a result made contact with SKY VINO.

Jumped only fairly.  Near the 1300 Metres, when racing keenly, got its head up when being shifted in to obtain a position with cover behind ROMANTIC LAOS.  Between the 450 Metres and the 300 Metres was held up for clear running.

On jumping was bumped by YUEN LONG ELITE which shifted in.  Bumped near the 300 Metres.  C Y Ho reported that from his wide barrier he was instructed to ride his mount in a conservative manner in the early stages.  He added that SKY VINO raced keenly and near the 1300 Metres got its head up when being steadied away from SIX PACK.  Trainer C Fownes confirmed the instructions issued.

After improving to the inside of LEGEND WINNER near the 1200 Metres was then steadied when LEGEND WINNER shifted in.  M Chadwick advised that his instructions were to hold a midfield position.  He said after jumping only fairly he was obliged to settle further back in the field than intended.  He said with the early stages of the event being run outside of standard time WINNING GOLD found it difficult to make up ground from back in the field in the Home Straight.

Jumped only fairly.  Near the 300 Metres was steadied when crowded between TOURBILLON PRINCE which shifted out after making contact with WITHALLMYFAITH and BLAZING WUKONG which shifted in after making contact with SIX PACK.

Shifted in at the start and was bumped.  H Doyle advised that her instructions were to go forward.  She said despite riding her mount along in the early stages YUEN LONG ELITE did not show sufficient pace to do so and as a result settled further back in the field than intended.  She added that YUEN LONG ELITE was obliged to race wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Near the 350 Metres was momentarily crowded between BEAUTY BOLT and WITHALLMYFAITH which shifted to the outside of URANUS STAR to obtain clear running.
From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

horses.short: Must pass veterinary exam before racing again
horses.incident_text: Withdrawn on 29.11.25 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame right hind) and replaced by Standby Declared Starter WINNING GOLD.  Before being allowed to race again, LEGENDARY YEARS will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

blackbook_suggestions.reason: Must pass vet exam before racing again
